description: Run a real statistical analysis of the user's own data in Phở: Phở profiles the file, proposes an analysis plan for the user to approve, then runs Python/R code in a sandbox and writes a report (with the code, figures and a .docx). Use it when the user has a dataset (CSV/TSV) and a question about it, e.g. "compare HbA1c between the two arms" or "what predicts readmission". Send the data inline as csv (up to ~900 KB) or as dataset_url, a direct link to a data file on an open-data host (Zenodo, Figshare, OSF, Dryad, GitHub raw, Hugging Face). Needs the user signed in to Phở. Free accounts get a few trial analyses; paid plans run on their plan. Returns at once with a run_id: call get_analysis_run until the plan is ready, show the plan, then approve_analysis_plan.

csv.description: The data as CSV or TSV text, with a header row.

dataset_url.description: Instead of csv: a direct link to a data file on an open-data host.

language.description: Language of the plan and report.

question.description: What the user wants to learn from the data, in their words.

name: run_analysis
title: Analyse a dataset with Phở
